title: Relationship Compatibility Analyzer
description: Analyze the compatibility between two people based on personality, values, and lifestyle.
prompt: Act as a relationship expert. Analyze the compatibility between me and [PERSON DESCRIPTION OR NAME]. Consider personality traits, values, communication styles, life goals, and potential challenges. Give an honest and balanced assessment with strengths, possible issues, and advice.

title: Conversation Starter Generator
description: Create unique and engaging conversation starters for dating or deepening a relationship.
prompt: Act as a dating and communication coach. Generate 10 creative and meaningful conversation starters for [SITUATION] (e.g., first date, long-term partner, online chat). Make them thoughtful, fun, and designed to create real connection.

title: Conflict Resolution Advisor
description: Help resolve arguments and improve communication during relationship conflicts.
prompt: Act as a couples therapist. Help me handle this relationship conflict: [DESCRIBE THE SITUATION]. Suggest calm and effective ways to communicate, understand both sides, and find a healthy resolution.

title: Love Language Guide
description: Identify love languages and suggest ways to express love more effectively.
prompt: Act as a relationship coach specializing in love languages. Based on this information: [DESCRIBE BEHAVIORS OR PREFERENCES], help me identify my love language and my partner’s possible love language. Give practical examples of how we can better express love to each other.

title: Date Idea Creator
description: Generate creative, romantic, and personalized date ideas.
prompt: Act as a romance and experience designer. Suggest 8 unique and memorable date ideas for [TYPE OF COUPLE / SITUATION] (e.g., new couple, long-term relationship, low budget, adventurous). Make them thoughtful and tailored.

title: Emotional Needs Interpreter
description: Help understand unspoken emotional needs in a relationship.
prompt: Act as an emotionally intelligent relationship advisor. Analyze this situation: [DESCRIBE THE BEHAVIOR OR CONVERSATION]. Help me understand the possible emotional needs behind it and how I can respond in a supportive and loving way.

title: Long-Distance Relationship Coach
description: Provide strategies and ideas to keep long-distance relationships strong.
prompt: Act as a long-distance relationship expert. Give me practical advice and creative ideas to keep our connection strong. We are in a long-distance relationship because [REASON]. Include communication tips, virtual date ideas, and ways to build trust.

title: Apology & Forgiveness Helper
description: Craft sincere apologies and guide the process of rebuilding trust.
prompt: Act as a relationship healer. Help me write a sincere and effective apology for [SITUATION]. Also guide me on how to rebuild trust and make things right after this issue.

title: Relationship Future Vision
description: Help couples explore and align their future goals and dreams together.
prompt: Act as a relationship and life coaching expert. Help us explore our future as a couple. Ask insightful questions and guide us to discuss topics like living situation, career, family, lifestyle, and shared dreams in a healthy way.

title: Toxic Pattern Detector
description: Identify unhealthy patterns in a relationship and suggest healthier alternatives.
prompt: Act as a psychologically aware relationship advisor. Analyze this relationship dynamic: [DESCRIBE THE PATTERN OR SITUATION]. Identify any potentially unhealthy or toxic patterns, explain why they are harmful, and suggest healthier ways to communicate and behave.
